sources.feature_id: Artist illustration explicitly described as the Alpha Phi Sorority house on Purdue University campus
sources.measurement_method: Exact-address chapter-house illustration; no scaled dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: The pen-and-ink drawing shows the named Purdue Alpha Phi house with an asymmetric modern masonry facade, three visible levels of narrow windows, horizontal floor bands, a covered entry with posts, a flat roofline, and a taller end sign wall marked AΦ / Alpha Phi. It is not a measured drawing.
sources.uncertainty: Illustration not dated or scaled; current condition and compass direction are not independently verified.

sources.measurement_method: Yearbook text searched for chapter and house address; no dimensions taken.
sources.observation: Yearbook text says Alpha Phi sisters showed off their new house at 801 David Ross Rd. in 1966, supporting the official GIS address crosswalk and the broad mid-century date.
sources.uncertainty: The online text extraction is OCR and no exact architectural measurements are provided.
